scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @ad-voice/ui && npm run typecheck --workspace @ad-voice/playground
scripts.build: npm run build:ui && npm run build:playground
scripts.release:patch: npm run check:catalog && node scripts/bump-and-package.mjs patch
scripts.release:minor: npm run check:catalog && node scripts/bump-and-package.mjs minor
scripts.release:major: npm run check:catalog && node scripts/bump-and-package.mjs major
scripts.check: npm run check:catalog && npm run typecheck
